request.subject: UNIT:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Change the helmet only: it becomes a closed steel great helm, a big rounded bucket helm that hides the whole face, with a narrow dark eye slit, a gold cross-shaped band on its front and a tall crimson plume standing on top. No face shows. Do not redraw anything else: keep the greatsword, plate armour, pauldron, crimson tabard with the gold cross, pose, proportions, feet, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
